name: Netlabel
about: Electronic, ambient and experimental records their makers set free under Creative Commons. Ambient alone through the small hours.

name: Drift
about: Long ambient, drone and piano for work and sleep, from musicians who set it free under Creative Commons.

name: Concert Hall
about: Bach, Chopin, Beethoven and more, in modern recordings free for anyone to play.

name: The Public Domain
about: Music and speech off records from 1925 and before. Each New Year's Day another year of them goes free.

name: Readings
about: Johnson's General History of the Pyrates, Treasure Island, Captain Blood, Moby-Dick and more of the sea, read aloud chapter by chapter.

name: Poets' Corner
about: Blake, Dickinson, Shelley, Owen and over a hundred more poets, read aloud. Nobody owns a word of it.

name: Shanties
about: Shanties, sea songs and pirate songs off 78s and field recordings, every one free to air.

name: Contraband
about: Books that kings, censors and courts tried to stop, read aloud round the clock. Milton, Paine, Douglass, Whitman, Wilde, Joyce, Lawrence.

name: Brass
about: Sousa's marches to 1926 by the Marine Band, with the bands of the Navy, Army and Air Force.
